--- title: "Juan Franco" jupyter: python3 --- Hi, I'm Juan Franco. I'm a Senior Data Analyst at Royal Caribbean Group, and I'm completing a master's degree in Business Analytics at Boston University. This site is my course ePortfolio for AD688, Big Data and Cloud Analytics for Business.
